items.text: IMF: We are advising central bankers to remain focused on price stability mandates; encouraging fiscal authorities to have medium-term consolidation plans.
IMF: Energy shock from war in the Middle East is not over; global debt pressures are mounting, and the disinflation process has stalled.
IMF: Global growth remains on track to reach about 3% in 2026, but risks remain high.
